_comment: Tietokoneet (games/robotti, omenalinja): generated by tools/tietokoneet/gen-voice.ts, same ids as voice/fi.json.

clips.tk_r_askeleet: The robot's battery is empty. Make it a program: press the arrows, then start with the green button.
clips.tk_r_toista: The robot has only a few places for its program. Make the pattern once and choose how many times it repeats.
clips.tk_r_jos: The robot walks by itself. When it steps on a coloured square, it turns. Choose an arrow for each colour.
clips.tk_r_tormasi: Oops, the robot crashed! The red arrow is a bug, a mistake. Fix it.
clips.tk_r_tormasi_jos: Oops, the robot crashed! Check the arrows of the colours.
clips.tk_r_ei_perille: The program ended, but the battery is still far away. Add more steps.
clips.tk_r_ikuinen: The robot goes round and round and never gets there.
clips.tk_r_vihje_askeleet: Follow the yellow dots. The first arrow is
clips.tk_r_vihje_toista: Look at the purple dots. That is the pattern that repeats. Make it once and count how many times it fits on the way.
clips.tk_r_vihje_jos: The white arrow shows where the path goes after the coloured square.
clips.ol_l1: Apples come along the line. You are the filter. Let the red apples go on and put the others in the bin.
clips.ol_l1_mato: The boss wants only red apples with no worm. Decide for each one: on or in the bin.
clips.ol_l2: Now the robot is the filter. Teach it a rule: tap the rule, choose a colour and start the line.
clips.ol_goal_red: Today the shop needs red apples.
clips.ol_goal_green: Today we make jam from green apples.
clips.ol_l3: Now we need both: red ones for the shop and green ones for jam. But no apples with worms.
clips.ol_l4: Apples that are too small are faulty, and a pumpkin jams the slicer. Add weight rules.
clips.ol_l5: A shoe and a banana got onto the line. Let only good apples go on.
clips.ol_pomo_hyva: The boss says: Great! All the apples are just right.
clips.ol_pomo_mato: The boss says: Some apples had worms!
clips.ol_pomo_pieni: The boss says: Some apples were too small.
clips.ol_pomo_vari: The boss says: Some apples were the wrong colour.
clips.ol_pomo_jumi: Oh no, the slicer jammed! Something that is not an apple got in.
clips.ol_pomo_hukka: The boss says: Good apples were thrown away. We needed them.
clips.ol_korjaa: Let's fix the filter and try again.
clips.ol_v_k1: Red apple on, the others in the bin.
clips.ol_v_vari_any: Both colours are needed. Choose any colour.
clips.ol_v_mato: Tap the worm rule: no worm.
clips.ol_v_yli: A small apple is lighter than a tennis ball. Choose: weight more than a tennis ball.
clips.ol_v_alle: A pumpkin is too heavy. Choose: weight less than a pumpkin.
clips.ol_v_omena: Tap the top rule: is an apple.
clips.ol_v_valmis: The rule looks good. Start the line.
